thread:
Jordan: FYI vendor flagged partial-DOA on H200 shipment arriving EU depot. 2/12 units failed POST at depot QC. They put arrival on hold pending RMA photos. Need decision: accept local swaps (refurbs) or insist on factory replacements and expedite.
Maya: ack. Which depot and what's the PO/AWB?
Jordan: details below. vendor contact is relief@logixx.co
```
PO: PO-7721
AWB: LXLXEU1234567890
Units: 12 H200
Depot: FRA-DC7
Arrived: 2024-04-01
DOA: 2 units (serials provided)
```
Theo: Depot says they can swap with refurbished cores from their local pool within 48h, but that triggers a refurbishment credit and extended warranty adjustment. Factory RMA replacements would be ~10 business days.
Nadia: For inference load: losing 2 H200s = ~12% reduction on our training edge lanes; prod-rtg unaffected for now because of overprovisioning, but we have high-priority scheduled jobs later this week.
Ivy: Do we have loaner spares? loaner-pool shows 0 for H200. Could we borrow H100s temporarily? performance mismatch but might help critical jobs.
Jordan: Vendor proposes two options: (A) local swap now -> get units online ~48h, accept refurb credit -$4k/unit; (B) factory replacements -> ETA 10 business days, new warranty. They also offered an expedited air replacement for the 2 DOA units at +$5k/unit (next-flight) if we sign expedited waiver.
Maya: Finance: rough numbers, local swap saves time but lowers net value. Factory replace keeps assets new but long lead. Expedited air costs +$10k total. Can we negotiate partial expedite (1 unit air, 1 local swap)?
Theo: Depot can pre-clear refurbished units without customs, that saves ~2 days. But we need completed RMA photos and signed custody transfer form. I'll push for a 1-air / 1-swap split to hedge.
ops-bot: RMA ticket created: RMA-9017. Depot QC photos requested.
Jordan: Vendor uploaded photo set and serials. Photos look like POST fail (fan spin-up). Template they want: serial, photo front, photo port-label, failure note.
Nadia: Mitigation: I'll reschedule non-urgent training to later and reassign critical jobs to surplus capacity. Also increase cache TTL on top-tier models to reduce transient inference pressure.
Ivy: If we do 1-air + 1-swap, which region gets the air unit? Suggest central EU (eu-central) to service scheduled jobs. Edge lanes can take the refurb.
Maya: Approve 1-air + 1-swap conditional on vendor reducing expedite surcharge to +$3k/unit and covering courier insurance value net-of-discounts. @Finance please confirm.
Theo: I've asked vendor for courier quote and insurance terms. Also requested full manifest and proof of refurbished test report.
Jordan: Vendor replied: willing to reduce expedite to +$3k/unit if we accept refurb credit -$3k on swapped unit. Courier requires declared value at invoice by default; vendor said they'll request net-of-discounts but no guarantee.
Maya: Finance approves conditional on net-of-discounts for insurance or vendor taking extra insurance premium. We don't want to absorb full declared value risk.
ops-bot: Note: cross-border customs check flagged for refurb units historically. Vendor must provide pre-clear packet to avoid depot hold.
Theo: Vendor provided pre-clear packet draft and refurbished test report. They also confirmed local swap units pass extended burn-in 4h.
Jordan: Decision: proceed with split (1 expedited air replacement to eu-central, 1 local swap to FRA-DC7). Approved surcharges per finance: expedite +$3k, refurb credit -$3k. Ivy/Nadia, please adjust runbooks.
Nadia: On it. I'll post a short ops plan to #eng-oncall with rollback steps and job reschedule list.
Ivy: I'll prepare a temporary QoS rule to deprioritize background jobs until the replacement lands.
Maya: Pinging vendor for AWB and courier invoice. Also requested they accept insurance amendment to declared value.
Theo: Depot confirms they can process the swap on receipt of signed custody form and photos. Uploading custody form now.
Jordan: AWB for air leg: LXLXEU1234567890-EXP (flight ETD 2024-04-03). Vendor says ETA at eu-central node 2024-04-04.
ops-bot: RMA-9017 updated: air-leg booked, local swap scheduled, documents uploaded.
Maya: Courier invoice shows insurance at invoice value; vendor agreed to cover additional premium to reduce our exposure. They will absorb up to $2k of excess.
Nadia: Mitigation in place. Monitoring GPU utilization and queue length. Will update every hour.
Ivy: QoS rules active. Background batch throughput -40%.
Theo: Depot confirms refurbished unit tested and staged for swap. Awaiting courier pickup for air unit.
Jordan: Thanks team. Closing thread once air unit accepted and local swap completed. Keep RMA-9017 open until depot sign-off. :white_check_mark:
